title: guides: remove remaining guide-invented keywords
description: Left by the guide-fix pass: delegation guide section 7 SHOULDs (presence, DND, ring rate-limit; one self-contradicts: 'SHOULD respect busy' vs 'busy does not block rings'); delegation guide 'A note on RFC 2119 keywords' says guides may use keywords for best practice, conflicting with the keyword rule; implementer guide MUSTs at ~147, 295, 315, 394, 469, 529, 580, 781 not audited; guide SHOULDs in e2ee/filenode guides not audited.
close_reason: Moot: guides keep their own keywords (decision 2026-10-20); the one real contradiction (busy presence) was fixed in the keyword pass.
